wins.label: Exceptional Data Center Growth
wins.evidence: Data Center revenue of $18.4 billion was a record, up 27% sequentially and up 409% year-on-year

wins.label: Broad Industry Adoption
wins.evidence: Building and deploying AI solutions has reached virtually every industry. Nearly every Automotive company working on AI is working with NVIDIA

wins.label: Strong Inference Revenue Growth
wins.evidence: We estimate in the past year, approximately 40% of Data Center revenue was for AI inference

wins.label: Software Business Momentum
wins.evidence: Software and services offerings reached an annualized revenue run rate of $1 billion in Q4

wins.label: Supply Chain Improvement
wins.evidence: We are delighted that supply of Hopper architecture products is improving. Overall, our supply is improving

risks.label: China Market Restrictions
risks.evidence: Data Center revenue declined significantly following the U.S. government export control regulations imposed in October. China represented a mid-single-digit percentage of our Data Center revenue in Q4

risks.label: Next Generation Supply Constraints
risks.evidence: We expect our next generation products to be supply constrained as demand far exceeds supply

risks.label: Gross Margin Normalization
risks.evidence: Beyond Q1, for the remainder of the year, we expect gross margins to return to the mid-70s percent range

risks.label: Operating Expense Growth
risks.evidence: Fiscal year 2025 GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses are expected to grow in the mid-30% range

risks.label: Forward-Looking Uncertainty
risks.evidence: During this call, we may make forward-looking statements based on current expectations. These are subject to a number of significant risks and uncertainties
